perspective:
From Arthur Chung’s available perspective:

- He knows his own role/background: Arthur Chung, a plumber with a doctorate, who collaborates professionally with Teresa Ortega, a medical assistant, on community service projects.
- In the current project, he observes Teresa working hard and appearing overwhelmed. He believes she may need help and feels concerned for her well-being.
- He offers help. Teresa tells him she thinks she can manage, but there is a lot to do. He urges self-care and offers to help; Teresa accepts help organizing medical supplies.
- After offering help, Arthur believes Teresa is hesitant because she wants to prove her capability. He feels empathy and reassures her that accepting help does not mean she is incapable. Teresa tells him she wants to show she can do it by herself; he responds that teamwork can be more effective and it is not about proving anything. Teresa says she sometimes needs to remind herself of that.
- Later, Arthur believes Teresa is still struggling and feels frustrated that his help is not yielding results. He tells her things still seem tough and that she is doing a great job. Teresa says it has been a busy day and she feels behind. He proposes working together rather than just helping her; Teresa agrees.
- Arthur believes collaboration will ease Teresa’s burden and improve efficiency. He feels hopeful and commits to the collaborative approach. They agree he will handle inventory while Teresa manages patient records, checking in regularly. Teresa says it already feels less overwhelming and she is glad they are working together.
- At the end, Arthur believes their teamwork has strengthened their professional relationship and feels satisfied. He tells Teresa their teamwork paid off and proposes continuing the collaborative approach in future projects. Teresa agrees, says it was a great experience, and thanks him as a supportive colleague.

Arthur does not have access to Teresa’s private thoughts or narrator-only facts except as she states them or as he observes/infers them.
